custom_patch_rules.description: Bypass internal Horizon Android egui launcher_pages unless HORIZON_SHOW_INTERNAL_UI is set, keeping all code reachable.
Auto-boot directly into Minecraft 26.3 on resumed(), sanitize .hmod files, inject custom_skin_active.png into 9 default player skin slots, and write real-time milestones to zalith-game-boot.txt.
Use jsDelivr CDN mirror + valid 1x1 PNG fallback so touch control verification never stalls at 27% (17/60).
Export JNI functions nativeIsGameInstalled, nativeStartOfficialInstall, and nativeGetInstallProgress with pause/resume/cancel & speed logging.
